تعترفين (form VIII)
# تَعْتَرِفِينَ (taʕtarifīna) /taʕ.ta.ri.fiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِعْتَرَفَ (iʕtarafa)
# تُعْتَرَفِينَ (tuʕtarafīna) /tuʕ.ta.ra.fiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَرَفَ (iʕtarafa)
